title: VibeJam: A User Study Platform for Web Development with Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.29889v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Programming with AI is increasingly agentic, users prompt LLMs to directly edit their code and review the changes, with adoption growing especially for web development tasks. Despite this growth, most NLP work uses offline evaluation and lacks support for online studies, losing insights into how programmers truly use coding agents. We release VibeJam, a browser-based user study platform for users to collaborate with AI agents to develop websites. VibeJam enables agent customization and uses the open-source Aider agent by default, and to mirror downstream use, we add diff review, chat and plan modes, and live website previews. In a pilot study with 55 released, game-based website creation tasks, five experienced AI programmers rate our system as fun, simple, and resembling commercial tools, while 13 junior students use VibeJam to make websites of higher quality than agents in the same task. translated_title: VibeJam：一个用于与智能体协作进行网页开发的用户研究平台
translated_abstract: 使用AI进行编程正日益呈现智能体化趋势，用户通过提示词让大语言模型直接编辑代码并审查更改，这种模式在网页开发任务中的采用尤其快速增长。尽管如此，大多数NLP研究仍采用离线评估，缺乏对在线研究的支持，从而无法深入了解程序员如何真正使用编程智能体。我们发布了VibeJam，这是一个基于浏览器的用户研究平台，让用户能够与AI智能体协作开发网站。VibeJam支持智能体定制，默认使用开源的Aider智能体，并且为了贴近实际下游使用场景，我们加入了差异审查、聊天与规划模式以及实时网站预览功能。在一项包含55个已发布的基于游戏的网站创建任务的初步研究中，五名经验丰富的AI程序员评价该系统有趣、简单且接近商业工具，同时13名低年级学生使用VibeJam制作的网站质量高于智能体在同一任务中的独立产出。我们将VibeJam开源，以促进后续扩展和研究。
tldr: VibeJam是一个开源的基于浏览器的用户研究平台，支持用户与AI智能体协作开发网站，并具备差异审查、规划模式和实时预览等功能，填补了编程智能体在线用户研究的空白。
en_tdlr: VibeJam is an open-source browser-based user study platform that enables users to collaborate with AI agents on web development, featuring diff review, plan modes, and live previews to fill the gap in online studies of coding agents.
